about.intro: Advanced view: an ImageJ-style editor for the slice you chose in the Studio. It works on the lossless voxels of the dataset.
about.source: Several slices are flattened into one with Z Project, as ImageJ's ZProjector does: Max, Min, Average and Median stay 8-bit on the stored data (an original TIFF keeps its own depth for Max, Min and Average), Sum and Standard Deviation are 32-bit.
about.depth: Display changes (brightness, contrast, lookup tables, threshold overlay) never touch the pixels; Apply, filters and type changes do, and can be undone while memory allows.
about.deviations: Differences from ImageJ: Clear and Clear Outside use 0 (black) and Fill uses the maximum value, because fluorescence images have a dark background; Convert to Mask and Threshold Apply create a new image.
about.storage: Your work is saved in this browser as you go, so a crash or a closed tab does not lose it. Save as TIFF to keep a file.
about.tables: Table windows (lists, colocalization results, distributions) and plot windows are not kept when the page is reloaded: copy them or save them as CSV or PNG. Results stay saved with your work.
about.famDisplay: Image: brightness and contrast, threshold, lookup tables, type conversion, crop, duplicate and Z Project.
about.famSelect: Selections: rectangle, oval, polygon, freehand, line, segmented line, angle, points and the Wand; Specify, Enlarge, Fit Ellipse, Convex Hull, Create Mask and Create Selection; the ROI Manager with Measure and Multi Measure.
about.famBackground: Background and contrast: Subtract Background (rolling ball and sliding paraboloid) and Enhance Contrast (saturated pixels, Normalize, Equalize).
about.famFilters: Filters and math: Smooth, Sharpen, Find Edges, Gaussian Blur, Median, Mean, Minimum, Maximum, Unsharp Mask, Variance, Top Hat, Convolve, Despeckle, Remove Outliers, Remove NaNs and the Process > Math functions.
about.famBinary: Binary: Erode, Dilate, Open, Close, Outline, Fill Holes, Skeletonize, Distance Map, Ultimate Points, Watershed, Voronoi, and Find Maxima.
about.famMulti: Several images and channels: Image Calculator, Split Channels, Merge Channels, Arrange Channels and Rename.
about.famGeometry: Geometry and calibration: Rotate, Scale, Size, Canvas Size, Translate, Bin, Properties and Set Scale.
about.famMeasure: Measurements: Measure, Analyze Particles, Summarize, Distribution, Histogram and Plot Profile, with Set Measurements (shape descriptors, Feret, Redirect to, Limit to threshold).
about.famColoc: Colocalization: Pearson, Manders, Costes automatic threshold and Li's ICQ, with a 2D histogram.
about.famThreshold: Thresholds: Auto Threshold and Auto Local Threshold with every Fiji method (Try all included), Make Binary and Binary Options.
about.famEnhance: Local contrast and noise: CLAHE, Add Noise, Add Specified Noise, Salt and Pepper, Tubeness and Frangi vesselness.
about.famFft: Frequency domain: FFT, Inverse FFT, FFT Options, Bandpass Filter, Swap Quadrants and Directionality.
about.famSelOps: Selection operations: Fit Spline, Fit Circle, Fit Rectangle, Interpolate, Scale, Rotate, Make Band, Straighten, Line to Area and Area to Line.
about.famEdit: Editing and overlays: Cut, Copy, Paste with Paste Control, Copy to System, Draw, Fill, New Image, Make Montage, lookup-table files, Image › Overlay, Grid, Scale Bar and Edit › Options.
about.famFiji: Fiji analysis: Coloc 2, Cell Counter, Analyze Skeleton, Local Thickness, Fractal Box Count and Curve Fitting.
about.famFiles: Files and views: Open from Library (another dataset of the site, as a z-stack projection or an oblique plane, from its original TIFF when there is one), ROI files and ROI sets, text images, XY coordinates; every image in its own view, which can be split, tabbed, docked or floated.
about.missing: Orthogonal Views, 3D Project and the other 3D tools (3D filters such as Gaussian Blur 3D), virtual stacks, macros, text and arrows, Bio-Formats, surface plots and the Wand's Legacy mode.
about.resultsWindow: Window > Results is the measurement table every Analyze command writes to (Measure, Analyze Particles, the ROI Manager, Histogram statistics): one row per measurement, the columns chosen in Set Measurements. Its Edit and File menus copy the table or save it as CSV.
about.pixelSource: The pixels of an image opened from the Studio come from the dataset's original TIFF when the dataset has one and the z-stack was chosen (its own bit depth and calibration), otherwise from the processed volume (8-bit, lossless).

dev.autoLocalPhansalkar: Auto Local Threshold, Phansalkar: a few pixels differ from Fiji on the images used to check it.
dev.autoLi16: Auto Threshold, Li, on a 16-bit image with the Ignore options: the level can be one unit away from Fiji's.
dev.autoStack: Auto Threshold: the Stack and Use stack histogram options are not offered (the Studio has channels, not stacks).
dev.skeleton: Analyze Skeleton: when cycles are pruned the same voxel is cut as in Fiji, but the order of the cuts can differ on some lattices; Branch information lists the branches in another order, with another first end and running average.
dev.coloc: Coloc 2: the default Costes threshold search stops by another rule than Fiji's; Bisection on a negative slope gives 255 / 13 where Fiji gives 253 / 14; the log columns "% zero-zero", "% saturated", "b to y-mean ratio" and the integrated intensities are not written.
dev.selection: Selections: Interpolate does not apply Fiji's clause for a magnification of 12 or more, and a selection of several parts is interpolated as one even-odd union; Straighten always shows its dialog, does not write the line width back and refuses a rotated rectangle.
dev.traced: Traced and composite selections: the start vertex and the order of the vertices can differ from Fiji's (visible in Save XY Coordinates).
dev.plot: Plot: every symbol is drawn as a square marker; there is no secondary fill colour and no Visible field.
dev.particles: Analyze Particles: a binary image without a threshold is read as 255 = foreground (no Black background or inverting look-up table logic).
dev.directionality: Directionality: at most 100 pieces are analysed; the result text says so when some were dropped.
dev.invertLut: Invert LUTs on a composite image shown in Composite mode is refused; switch to Color or Grayscale first.
dev.log: There is no Log window: the values ImageJ writes there appear in the status bar.

about.fijiDeviations: Analyze Skeleton: a pruned skeleton comes out as a new image, "<name>-pruned", instead of changing the source. Coloc 2 shows no result images, Cell Counter has no Keep Original or Show All, and Curve Fitting has no "Show settings" and no user-defined formula.
